# Component reference

36 components. Every one ships `.jsx` (source), `.d.ts` (props) and
`.prompt.md` (when to use it, with an example) side by side — read the `.prompt.md` before
using a component for the first time.

In React, import from `index.js`. In a static page, load `_ds_bundle.js` and read components
off `window.RedeSescDeEducaODesignSystem_2167ce`. See [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

### Icon

Line-icon primitive — the single source of truth for iconography. 24×24 grid, 2px stroke, inherits `currentColor`. Pass to Button/IconButton via `icon`. Returns null for an unknown name, so a typo fails visibly in review rather than rendering a broken glyph.

| prop | type | required | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `IconName` | yes | Which glyph to render |
| `size` | `number` | — | Pixel size (width & height), default 20 |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | — | Stroke weight, default 2 — the grid these icons are drawn on |
| `color` | `string` | — | Stroke colour; defaults to currentColor so it inherits text colour |
| `title` | `string` | — | Accessible label. Omit for decorative icons (rendered aria-hidden) |

`components/core/Icon.jsx` · [props](../components/core/Icon.d.ts) · [usage](../components/core/Icon.prompt.md)

## Brand

### BrandMotif

The official "cubo impossível" motif — the brand's central visual idea, supplied by Sesc as vector artwork and split into six constructions. Renders the supplied colours untouched unless `hue` asks for another family. Never re-maps per theme. Returns null for an unknown variant.

| prop | type | required | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `MotifVariant` | — | Which official construction to render (default 'cube') |
| `size` | `number` | — | Rendered square size in px (default 240) |
| `title` | `string` | — | Accessible label. Omit when decorative (rendered aria-hidden) |
| `opacity` | `number` | — | Fade the motif when it sits behind content (default 1) |
| `hue` | `MotifHue` | — | * Restate the construction in another palette family. Omit to render the exact fills Sesc
   * supplied — the sheet ships green, blue and pink only, so this is how the other three
   * families are reached. Ramps derive from the published palette, never from the artwork. |

`components/brand/BrandMotif.jsx` · [props](../components/brand/BrandMotif.d.ts) · [usage](../components/brand/BrandMotif.prompt.md)

### PlatformEntry

Co-branded entry point from a Rede Sesc de Educação surface into the Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA. One click from a marketing page to the platform's home — see docs/sabia-platform.md.

| prop | type | required | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` | — | Where the platform lives. Ask Sesc for the real URL — there is no default. |
| `logoSrc` | `string` | — | Sab.IA lockup, e.g. assets/logos/sabia-wordmark-cream.svg on purple |
| `logoAlt` | `string` | — |  |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | — | Uppercase label shown when no logoSrc is given |
| `title` | `string` | — |  |
| `description` | `string` | — |  |
| `ctaLabel` | `string` | — |  |
| `tone` | `'purple' \| 'cream'` | — | purple = solid Sab.IA purple band; cream = quiet block on a cream page |
| `note` | `string` | — | Small print under the description (audience, access conditions) |
